notice: Bibliographic metadata, links and original summaries only; remote-viewing, telepathy and aura claims are not presented as established facts. No copyrighted source PDFs have been imported.

ingest_policies.fulltext_candidate: Original historical work/asset has a strong public domain indication, but verify this edition, attribution and NZ/worldwide rights before mirroring.
ingest_policies.source_only_pending_edition: Original old work may be public domain, but a particular transcription or scanned edition has not passed reuse check.
ingest_policies.index_only: Save author, citation, link and research notes only. Do not copy source documents.
ingest_policies.research_data_permission_check: Data can be accessed for research, but licence and provider usage terms require a separate check before republishing.
ingest_policies.licensed_after_credit: Source claims a permissive attribution licence; check exact version/asset and retain credit.

items.title: The Human Atmosphere, or, The Aura Made Visible by the Aid of Chemical Screens
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Historical aura descriptions, diagrams and case records. Aura diagnostic claims unverified.

items.title: Thought-Forms
items.rights_statement: Public domain USA (Project Gutenberg); authors died 1933 and 1934
items.editorial_note: Illustrated map of claimed thought forms, colour meanings and clairvoyance. Illustrations from period edition require asset-level provenance.

items.title: The Human Aura: Astral Colors and Thought Forms
items.rights_statement: Public domain USA (Project Gutenberg); author died 1932
items.editorial_note: Older speculative aura-colour system, practical suggestions and philosophy; not validated science.

items.title: Clairvoyance
items.rights_statement: Public domain USA (Project Gutenberg); author died 1934
items.editorial_note: Leadbeater theoretical taxonomy of claimed clairvoyant abilities.

items.title: Mental Radio
items.rights_statement: Public domain USA (Project Gutenberg); literary author died 1968
items.editorial_note: Book describing Mary Craig Sinclair reported thought/drawing transmission experiments, with methodological criticisms.

items.title: Human Personality and Its Survival of Bodily Death
items.rights_statement: Public domain USA (Project Gutenberg); author died 1901
items.editorial_note: Comprehensive early psychical research text; this Gutenberg edition edited and abridged by L. H. Myers.

items.title: Phantasms of the Living (two volumes)
items.rights_statement: Original nineteenth-century work public domain NZ; modern transcriptions may carry restrictions
items.editorial_note: Contemporaneous accounts of apparent telepathy and apparitions; source editions and cases should be page-cited. Do not bulk-import Esalen modern transcription (CC BY-NC-ND).

items.title: Man Visible and Invisible
items.rights_statement: Historical text likely public domain NZ; source scan rights unverified
items.editorial_note: Illustrated aura atlas described on author bibliography; verify specific downloadable file before mirroring.

items.title: The Rationale of Mesmerism
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Period exposition of mesmerism, a historically significant but unreliable medical theory.

items.title: Etherology, or, The Philosophy of Mesmerism and Phrenology
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Historical framework for mesmerism/phrenology and claimed mental influences; phrenology pseudoscientific.

items.title: On Mesmerism
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Nineteenth-century work (date approximate: catalog dates between 1800 and 1899).

items.title: What Is Mesmerism? Mesmerism Not Miracle
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Historical mesmeric healing claims; not medical advice or validated treatment.

items.title: How to Mesmerise
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: 1890s illustrated manual; approximate year 1890-1899. Treat methods as historical, not validated.

items.title: IAPSOP Periodicals and Standard Spiritualist and Occult Corpus
items.rights_statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 IAPSOP/SSOC; bulk redistribution/commercial use restricted
items.editorial_note: Approximately 4.95 million pages and 1.2 TB; catalogue/link only without separate rights clearance; archive server explicitly throttles bots.

items.title: Journal of the Society for Psychical Research, early volumes
items.rights_statement: Issue-level rights vary; pre-1900 editions often old; source scan conditions vary
items.editorial_note: Periodical archive directory for historical experiments and case studies.

items.title: Society for Psychical Research institutional archive
items.rights_statement: Access and copying limited for archival manuscripts
items.editorial_note: Cambridge archival holdings including correspondence, equipment and audiovisual material.

items.title: American Society for Psychical Research historical journal
items.rights_statement: Rights vary by individual article
items.editorial_note: Index of historical published studies and their scans.

items.title: Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research published work
items.rights_statement: Publisher/article rights not fully verified
items.editorial_note: Approximately 62 publication entries covering remote perception and human-machine interaction. Do not treat claimed anomalous effects as established.

items.title: Consciousness and Anomalous Physical Phenomena
items.rights_statement: PDF accessible; reuse/redistribution rights unverified
items.editorial_note: PEAR overview; full document is linked rather than bundled.

items.title: Global Consciousness Project random event generator network
items.rights_statement: Public CSV extraction provided; site copyright reserved; reuse terms need confirmation
items.editorial_note: 1998 onward global random event recordings. Account for documented hardware errors; compare pre-registered event windows and baselines.

items.title: Global Consciousness Project known data errors
items.rights_statement: Copyright reserved; link only
items.editorial_note: Machine-specific faults and timestamps essential for any reproducible reanalysis.

items.title: 1974–2018 Ganzfeld Database
items.rights_statement: Open dataset with citation requirement; check file-level licence before redistribution
items.editorial_note: Spreadsheet metadata aggregating ganzfeld studies and reported outcomes, not raw individual trials.

items.title: Anomalous Perception in a Ganzfeld Condition: 1974–2020 meta-analysis
items.rights_statement: Open-access article CC BY 4.0; linked Figshare data rights to verify
items.editorial_note: Authors report small pooled effect; interpretation disputed and does not establish telepathy. Study-level datasets and analysis syntax reported.

items.title: STAR GATE remote viewing historical document guide
items.rights_statement: Mixed government/contractor/third-party documents; each item needs rights audit
items.editorial_note: Guide to declassified remote viewing session records, training material, sketches and assessments from 1972–1995.

items.title: Did CIA Really Study Psychic Powers?
items.rights_statement: US government agency publication; third-party exceptions possible
items.editorial_note: CIA account confirms programme existed, was assessed and not resumed as operational intelligence.

items.title: Duke ESP / Zener cards museum record
items.rights_statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for digitised exhibit; no commercial redistribution without clearance
items.editorial_note: Digitised ESP card artefact and historic experimental context.

items.title: Image Modulation in Corona Discharge Photography
items.rights_statement: Journal rights; abstract/index only
items.editorial_note: Scientific analysis attributes most image variation to moisture and corona discharge; useful control for aura claims.

items.title: Researches in the Phenomena of Spiritualism
items.rights_statement: Public Domain Mark (Wellcome work)
items.editorial_note: Nineteenth-century scientist’s experimental apparatus and claimed psychic-force investigations; not accepted evidence of spirits.

items.title: Bibliography of Harold Saxton Burr
items.rights_statement: Open online bibliography; rights of each underlying paper vary
items.editorial_note: Extensive bibliography of bioelectric measurements and theorised organizing fields. Electrical phenomena are real; the broader speculative interpretations require independent evaluation.

items.title: Telepathic Perception in the Dream State: EEG-EOG Monitoring Techniques
items.rights_statement: Publisher-restricted article; bibliographic link only
items.editorial_note: Historical REM-sleep dream-target correspondence experiment with reported positive results; later independent replication disputed.

items.title: Annotated Bibliography on Soviet-Bloc Parapsychology
items.rights_statement: Declassified document; embedded third-party citations may have independent copyright
items.editorial_note: 1964 bibliography indexing Soviet-bloc scientific literature about parapsychology, hypnotism and biomagnetism; evidence of research interest, not validation.

items.title: STAR GATE declassified collection
items.rights_statement: Published government records; third-party materials and privacy restrictions may apply
items.editorial_note: Official searchable entry point. CIA confirmed 11,985 documents and 89,901 pages in a 2006 FOIA response. Declassification does not validate claims.

items.title: CIA letter: Size and Scope of the STAR GATE Collection
items.rights_statement: US government record; verify any third-party rights before copying
items.editorial_note: CIA's contemporaneous records count and scope of related programme names.

items.title: An Evaluation of Remote Viewing: Research and Applications
items.rights_statement: CIA hosted review/summary; rights of external contributors need verification
items.editorial_note: Operational review concluded remote-viewing reports were too vague and unreliable for intelligence; laboratory interpretation remained disputed.

items.title: Perceptual Augmentation Techniques, Part Two: Research Report
items.rights_statement: Declassified contractor report; third-party copyright may apply
items.editorial_note: SRI authors reported positive results. Study design, judging, sensory leakage and subsequent replications remain essential context.

items.title: Remote-Viewing Field Experiments: Original Protocol Material
items.rights_statement: Declassified report; individual content reuse review required
items.editorial_note: Original experimental narratives, blind-ranking procedures and descriptions of false matches. Year approximate, 1970s.

items.title: PEAR Laboratory Technical Notes (55 items)
items.rights_statement: Finding aid accessible; original notes subject to institutional archive rights
items.editorial_note: Princeton finding aid lists 55 PEAR technical notes. Decades of laboratory research; do not assert anomalous effects established.

items.title: Early Studies in Parapsychology at Duke
items.rights_statement: University exhibit; permission needed for rehosting images/archival documents
items.editorial_note: Duke curated exhibition based on Parapsychology Laboratory Records (1893–1984).

items.title: Rhine Research Center Research Library and Journal
items.rights_statement: Institutional library and journal; full text not licensed for redistribution
items.editorial_note: Rhine states it holds a complete Journal of Parapsychology from 1937 onward; catalogue and link only.

items.title: Global Consciousness Project: Original Raw Data Access
items.rights_statement: Research access documented; confirm data redistribution/licence
items.editorial_note: Original EGG network data available through project-specific extract mechanisms. Statistical associations contested.

items.title: GCP Control Experiments and Pseudo-EGG Data
items.rights_statement: Research links and historical control descriptions; offline dataset requires request
items.editorial_note: Control-data design proposed in 2001; linked pseudoegg database now offline and access by request.

items.title: Global Consciousness Project: Known Hardware and Data Errors
items.rights_statement: Public project documentation; reference and link
items.editorial_note: Essential exclusions for independent analysis. Device failures have been recorded and must be handled.

items.title: Vnushenie na rasstoianii (Mental Suggestion at a Distance)
items.rights_statement: 1962 Soviet publication; rights and scan provenance unresolved
items.editorial_note: Russian original describes long-distance hypnotic suggestion experiments. Inadequate independent replication and reporting concerns.

items.title: Experiments in Distant Influence
items.rights_statement: English translation/publisher copyright not cleared
items.editorial_note: Bibliographic record of English translation of Vasiliev's work; no permission to host scanned translation established.

items.title: Leonid Vasiliev: Research and Critical Reception
items.rights_statement: Copyrighted modern reference article; link only
items.editorial_note: Details Soviet programme, published allegations, limitations and criticism of reporting.

items.title: The Power of the Mind over the Body
items.rights_statement: Wellcome Public Domain Mark
items.editorial_note: Early critical inquiry into effects attributed to Baron Reichenbach's 'imponderable' force. Valuable contemporary counterpoint.

items.title: The Book of the Damned
items.rights_statement: Project Gutenberg: public domain USA; historical author died 1932; check edition and NZ rights
items.editorial_note: Classic catalogue of anomalous reports. Many anecdotes lack independent corroboration; tag events as allegations.

items.title: New Lands
items.rights_statement: Project Gutenberg: check source edition, local rights and possible corrections
items.editorial_note: Fortean accounts involving astronomy and unusual observations, not a verified physics theory.

items.title: Charles T. Tart: Published Research Bibliography
items.rights_statement: Copyrighted compiled bibliography; titles, author, year and links only
items.editorial_note: Long bibliography for researcher dossier and crosslinks; bibliographic coverage begins 1962.

items.title: Image Modulation in Corona Discharge Photography
items.rights_statement: Abstract is publicly accessible; article reuse not cleared
items.editorial_note: Physical explanation of many Kirlian image variations through corona discharge, moisture and circuit parameters; not proof of paranormal auras.
